没有时间惊讶，蓝若晴上前大力的推动沈沛珊，“母亲！母亲！”却不曾想怎样都叫不醒她。
同样叫着师伯辰一诺，也是沉睡不醒。
心中顿悟二人并非是私混后的沉睡不醒，而是着了奸人的道，被人用了迷药。
难怪一进屋子里时，闻到那种迷人的香气。现在想来，那并不是熏香，而是迷药了。
“冷静！现在需要的是冷静！”蓝若晴平复自己的思绪，想起母亲曾经说过的，中了迷药最好的办法就是用冷水激醒。
找到茶桌上的茶壶，蓝若晴倒了两杯冰冷的茶水，对着沈沛珊与辰一诺的脸泼下，只见得沈沛珊与辰一诺被凉水一激，悠然转醒。
看到站在一旁的蓝若晴，沈沛珊柔声的说道：“若晴，你来了。”
正想要起身，碰到身旁的辰一诺，沈沛珊吃惊的大喊一声：“一诺！你怎么在这里？”抬手便给了辰一诺一巴掌，回手拉紧了自己凌乱的衣服。
辰一诺本来被凉茶水浇完还没清醒，又被沈沛珊打了一巴掌，不由怒声道：“沛珊，你做什么？”突然看到周围陌生的环境，衣衫不整的沈沛珊，赤裸着上身的自己，及在一旁焦急的蓝若晴，即刻明白了，迅速跳到地上穿好衣服，沉声道：“沛珊，看来我们都着了道，快点穿好衣服，别让人抓到了把柄。”说完，头也没回的，越窗而出。
在辰一诺说话整理衣服的时候，蓝若晴已扶起沈沛珊，帮助她穿好衣衫，并用最快的速度收拾床铺。扶着母亲坐到梳妆台前，整理发饰。
“没想到他们的手段如此卑劣！”蓝若晴想起前世临死前，蓝汐冷说的话，这一次的事件，让自己误会母亲整整五年！“母亲，看来姨娘终究是不肯放过你的。”蓝若晴恨恨的说道。
“若晴，母亲被陷害到不打紧，可是他们怎能拉一诺下水？”沈沛珊也愤恨的说着。
“娘亲，我们不能再这样纵容姨娘与蓝汐冷，你我一味的忍让，只会让她们母女更加变本加厉。今日她们陷害的是母亲与师伯，明日她们陷害的就会是女儿。”整理好沈沛珊的妆容，蓝若晴继而说道：“母亲就是为了女儿明天的幸福，也要和姨娘争个高下不是？再任由她们母女二人胡作非为，恐怕女儿的明天不止是当作下堂妻那么简单，或许……”想起前世的遭遇，蓝若晴叹了口气说道：“或许女儿的性命都不保呢。”
“若晴，你说的对，是母亲做的不够好，让父亲与你我疏远。这以后，我定会让你父亲回到你我身边。”
轻抚蓝若晴的长发，沈沛珊似下定决心般，继续说道：“晴儿放心，母亲不会再让她们伤害我们。今日若不是你机警，恐我与一诺都难逃劫数。如若被他们抓到，后果可是不堪设想。伤害我，动摇我的地位也就算了，伤害了你与一诺，我是怎样都不肯放过她们的！”

> Chapter 19 Rescue 2 (Page 1)
There was no time to be surprised. Lan Ruoqing stepped forward and pushed Shen Peishan vigorously, "Mother! Mother!" But she never thought that she could not wake up no matter what.
He also called Master Chen Yinuo, but he also fell into a deep sleep.
In my heart, I realized that the two of them were not sleeping together after a private affair, but were being tricked by traitors and drugged.
No wonder you smell that charming aroma when you enter the house. Now that I think about it, it's not incense but drug.
"Calm down! What we need now is to calm down!" Lan Ruoqing calmed down her thoughts and remembered what her mother once said. The best way to wake up after being drugged is to use cold water to wake up.
Finding the teapot on the tea table, Lan Ruoqing poured two cups of cold tea and poured it on Shen Peishan and Chen Yinuo's faces. Shen Peishan and Chen Yinuo were shocked by the cold water and woke up leisurely.
Seeing Lan Ruoqing standing aside, Shen Peishan said softly: "Ruoqing, you are here."
Just as he was about to get up, when he met Chen Yinuo beside him, Shen Peishan shouted in surprise: "Yinuo! Why are you here?" She raised her hand and slapped Chen Yinuo, and then pulled back her messy clothes.
Chen Yinuo was still awake after being poured with herbal tea, but was slapped by Shen Peishan again. He couldn't help but said angrily: "Peishan, what are you doing?" Suddenly he saw the unfamiliar environment around him, the disheveled Shen Peishan, his naked body, and Lan Ruoqing, who was anxious at the side, understood immediately, quickly jumped to the ground and put on her clothes, and said in a deep voice: "Peishan, it seems that we are all in trouble, hurry up and get dressed before others get caught." After saying that, without looking back, he walked out of the window.
While Chen Yinuo was talking and sorting out her clothes, Lan Ruoqing had already helped Shen Peishan up, helped her put on her clothes, and made the bed as quickly as possible. Helping her mother sit in front of the dressing table, arranging her hair accessories.
"I didn't expect their methods to be so despicable!" Lan Ruoqing recalled what Lan Xileng said before she died in her previous life. This incident made her misunderstand her mother for five years! "Mother, it seems that my aunt is unwilling to let you go after all." Lan Ruoqing said bitterly.
"Ruo Qing, it doesn't matter that my mother was framed, but how could they pull Yinuo into trouble?" Shen Peishan also said angrily.
"Mother, we can no longer indulge my aunt and Lan Xileng like this. Your and my blind tolerance will only make them worse. Today they are framed by their mother and uncle, and tomorrow they will be framed by their daughter." After finishing Shen Peishan's makeup, Lan Ruoqing continued, "My mother is For the sake of my daughter's happiness tomorrow, I have to compete with my aunt, right? If the mother and daughter are allowed to do whatever they want, my daughter's future may not be as simple as being a second cousin, maybe..." Thinking of what happened in her previous life, Lan Ruoqing sighed and said, "Maybe my daughter's life is not guaranteed."
"Ruo Qing, you are right. It was my mother who did not do a good enough job that caused my father to be alienated from you and me. From now on, I will definitely let your father come back to you and me."
Caressing Lan Ruoqing's long hair, Shen Peishan seemed to have made up her mind and continued: "Qing'er, don't worry, mother will not let them hurt us again. If you hadn't been alert today, I am afraid that Yinuo and I would not have escaped. If we were caught by them, the consequences would be disastrous. It's okay to hurt me and shake my position. If I hurt you and Yinuo, I will not let them go no matter what!"
